title: add jsonschema strict mode and improved error reporting for OpenAI compatibility
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We want first-class JSON Schema structured-output support (response_format=json_schema) that is OpenAI-compatible and adds a strict mode for production correctness checks. Previously we surfaced a loose validation pass/fail which was not actionable for integrators. This PR introduces a strict response_format mode that enforces schema validation at the response surface and returns an OpenAI-compatible error object instead of opaque text.

Summary of changes: adds a response_format.strict boolean that, when true, enforces schema validation for model outputs and returns an OpenAI-compatible error object when validation fails. Improves validation error messages to include error_code, message, json_pointer (path), expected_type, and sample_expected. Adds graceful fallback: on non-parsable output we emit the structured error over streaming boundary and surface retry hints for SDKs. Also updates the OpenAI compatibility layer to accept the new fields and map legacy response_format usages to the new API.
commits: feat(jsonschema): add response_format.strict flag and validation pipeline
feat(openai-compat): map legacy response_format keys to json_schema shape
perf(runtime): optimize jsonschema validator hot path and KV cache interactions
test: add unit/integration tests for strict-mode parse and validation errors
docs: update api/response_format.md with strict mode examples
review_thread: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Can we avoid blocking the streaming event loop for large schemas? Suggest offloading validation to a dedicated worker pool or using incremental validation.
Asha Patel (author): We added a worker-pool path and a fast-path validator for small schemas (<= 8 fields). See jsonschema.py::FastValidator. Perf tests in the PR show negligible p50 impact.
Priya Shah (reviewer): Please add clearer error_code constants and document them. Also prefer json_pointer over dotted paths for compatibility. Requested changes.
Asha Patel (author): Added ERROR_CODE constants and switched to json_pointer. Updated docs and tests.
Evan Liu (reviewer): Integration tests flaky on first run (network blip). Re-ran CI; all green. Approved.
Diego Martinez (reviewer): Approved after seeing perf numbers and tests.
release_notes: Adds response_format=json_schema strict mode with deterministic, OpenAI-compatible structured error responses on validation/parse failures. Opt-in via response_format.strict; non-strict behavior unchanged. Improved validation messages include error_code, json_pointer, expected_type, and example values. Feature is behind feature flag 'jsonschema_strict_v1' for staged rollout.
